messages:
Hiro Tanaka: Opening a tiny refresh PR for the Hello Quickstart. Main items: make CLI-first auth, add Windows PowerShell env example, note model alias rename, swap Docker base to a slim image, and fix an old /guides link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233
Sofia Ramos: Love the CLI-first approach. Can we keep a visible PowerShell example so Windows users don't get blocked? Something like: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = \"<KEY>\"`
Hiro Tanaka: Yep — top of page will show `redwood login --api-key <KEY>` and right below a one-line PowerShell env example and a collapsed \"CI / env\" panel with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and a GitHub Actions snippet.
Kayla (Docs): Quick style nits: change any previous \"no rate limits\" phrasing to \"soft limits apply on free tier; see pricing\" and link to pricing. Also include a 1-line note about token scoping (user vs org tokens) to avoid cross-account 403s.
Hiro Tanaka: Updated wording to \"soft limits on free tier; see pricing\" and added a short token-scope callout.
Devon Li: The SDK snippets should show a region variant for EU customers, e.g. `RedwoodClient(region=\"eu-west-1\")`. Realtime customers often miss region-specific endpoints.
Hiro Tanaka: Added `RedwoodClient()` and `RedwoodClient(region=\"eu-west-1\")` examples inline. Also added a one-line wscat example for realtime quicktests.
Sofia Ramos: Migration note request: many repos still reference `redwood/helium-v1`. Please add a safe repo migration helper and a macOS-safe alternative.
Hiro Tanaka: Included two helpers: `git grep -l \"helium-v1\" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and macOS: `git grep -l \"helium-v1\" | xargs sed -i '' 's/helium-v1/helium/g'`. Also added a `perl -pi -e` variant as an option.
Kayla (Docs): For Docker, switch the primary example to `node:18-bullseye-slim` (or `node:18-slim`) and append an Alpine variant in a small note. Label any single-line `kubectl run` examples as \"DEMO ONLY\" so folks don't assume production readiness.
Hiro Tanaka: Swapped Docker base to `node:18-bullseye-slim`, appended alpine snippet, and added a DEMO ONLY badge for the k8s example.
Devon Li: Tiny troubleshooting addition: include a curl auth check `curl -I -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and call out clock skew as a common 401 cause.
Hiro Tanaka: Added the curl check and a short troubleshooting FAQ entry.
docs-ci: Preview build queued for PR 5233 — running link checks and linting.
Kayla (Docs): Found a broken anchor in the old /guides/deploy link during linting. Please update to /learn/deploy and re-run the preview.
docs-ci: Lint caught the broken anchor; rebuild queued after fix.
Hiro Tanaka: Fixed the anchor and pushed. Rebuilding now.
docs-ci: Preview build passed: docs-ci/preview/5233 ✅ (staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/hello-quickstart/preview)
Sofia Ramos: Reviewed and approved. Thanks for keeping the PowerShell snippet visible — it removes a lot of friction for new Windows devs.
Hiro Tanaka: Great — merging in the next docs deploy window. Will follow up if any post-merge issues crop up. :shipit:
